summary: Comprehensive testing of Hotel Lobby Digital Signage app completed. All backend APIs (14/14 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Slide rotation includes all 4 slide types (photo, weather, attractions, events) with dynamic weather-reactive backgrounds based on live API data.
passed_tests: Backend: Health endpoint shows weather_api_configured=true, news_api_configured=true
Backend: GET /api/weather returns live data (Scattered Clouds, 42°F, icon 03d)
Backend: GET /api/settings returns correct config (Velkommen Inn, Clifton Texas, photo_interval=8, weather_slide_duration=15)
Backend: GET /api/images returns 5 default hotel images
Backend: GET /api/news returns live headlines from NewsAPI
Frontend: Lobby display loads at / with data-testid='lobby-display'
Frontend: Photo slides show hotel name, clock, weather widget, news headline
Frontend: Weather slide appears with dynamic WeatherBackground (cloudy theme for Scattered Clouds)
Frontend: Weather slide shows 6-day forecast, humidity, wind, visibility, precipitation
Frontend: Local Attractions slide appears with dynamic WeatherBackground (not fixed gradient)
Frontend: Events slide appears with dynamic WeatherBackground (not fixed gradient)
Frontend: Slide indicators at bottom show 8 slides (5 photos + 3 special slides)
Frontend: Slide rotation works - all 4 slide types observed during 70-second test
Frontend: Admin panel at /admin loads correctly with Images, Settings, Display tabs
Frontend: Admin Settings tab shows all configuration options
Frontend: Weather animations toggle present in admin settings
test_credentials: No authentication required. Admin panel at /admin is open access.
seed_data_creation: None - using default images and live API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All slide types (photo, weather, attractions, events) are working with dynamic WeatherBackground. Current weather is 'Scattered Clouds' which maps to 'cloudy' theme. Slide rotation timing: photo=8s, weather=15s, special slides=12s. Admin panel has 3 tabs: Images, Settings, Display. All APIs are live (OpenWeatherMap, NewsAPI).
